title: Senior Backend Engineer - Product (Remote)
description: Senior product-oriented backend engineering role on Finom's financial platform. Develop and evolve distributed production services, collaborate with product, mobile and frontend teams, review architecture tradeoffs, mentor colleagues and maintain testing and security quality. The position specifically requires strong .NET and C# skills; its stack includes PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes and GCP. Finom reports an established customer base and a €115 million Series C financing round, but the job salary is not published.

responsibilities: Collaborate on architecture, testing and reliability
requirements: At least five years backend development
